Senses.Explanation: Loyal words grate on the ear names unwelcome but faithful counsel. Mi'an Xianjie says loyal words agitate a listener, while Yulin Tongxiu’s correction of a shout from the assembly asks how the listener can bear words that grate on the ear. Yulin Tongxiu explicitly pairs bitter medicine with loyal words that grate on the ear; Dahui Zonggao uses the latter to divide quick recognition from dull reception. The phrase remains counsel and its unpleasant reception, not a special object.
